profile.source: S120 fresh audit; every premise read against live code at c6e9d691

gameLoopReview: No loop defect was reported or measured since S119's production verification. The player-visible gap is communication: S119 changed passer ratings that existing saves display (strong seasons read about ten points higher) and fixed the phone Desk, and the release notes still end at 2026-10-22. Players who notice a rating jump with no dated note read it as a bug.

L2.recipe: A dated 2026-10-23 release note on status.html naming both player-visible changes and the existing-save rating shift; sweep tests-ui specs/helpers and responsive-evidence for copy dependence; confirm the generated changelog page and feed carry it

L3.recipe: In-game 'what changed since you last played' notice keyed to the save's last-seen build

executionLog.note: 2026-10-23 note on public/status.html: phone Desk fit and the single passer-rating formula, stating that most passers in existing saves read higher (a strong season by up to about ten points) and that near-perfect low-volume backups can read lower; a zero-attempt passer reads 0, not 39.6. Facts checked by the independent review against statSchema.js/appCore.js and statBook.js (ratings are recomputed from stored stats, never persisted). No tests-ui or responsive-evidence copy dependence. check-public-truth OK; public tests 32/33, the 1 red is the known git-ignored private ledger (local only, not tracked).

skipped.reason: Real: game.html:902,906 show AFC/NFC bracket headings to players. Choosing fictional conference names is a naming decision with IP weight, and the copy is load-bearing in tests-ui (afc-bracket-table test ids). Stays on the Phase 1 board for its own step.
S119 measured 15.305 MB raw vs the 16 MB bar, with gzip absorbing the repeated seed; nothing this session adds a per-player field, so the migration stays deferred until one does.

initialReview: Fresh S120 audit after S119's verified production closeout. The brief's queue was exhausted. Every candidate was read against live code at c6e9d691; four survive, two are deferred with evidence.

rejectedOnVerify.evidence: Confirmed at public/game.html:902,906; deferred as its own naming step (see skipped).

rejectedOnVerify.premise: A new mechanic is the highest-value change this session
rejectedOnVerify.evidence: No measured loop defect since S119; the unannounced rating shift in existing saves is the live player-facing risk, so communication outranks a new mechanic.
Deterministic and local by design (static-host-safe success bar).

rejectedOnVerify.premise: Selected work adds an input or trust boundary
rejectedOnVerify.evidence: Static copy, a script launch option and a pure engine function; no request, storage or input path changes.
S119 measurement stands; no new per-player field this session.

rejectedOnVerify.premise: A separate honesty item is needed for the S119 rating shift
rejectedOnVerify.evidence: Covered by s119-release-note (ui-ux-feedback), which states the shift in existing saves; a second item would duplicate it.

review.note: Fresh-context reviewer: no correctness bugs. Fixed: release-note overclaim (rating gain depends on yards per attempt; some backups read lower) and the parity test now covers every Chromium launch, not two. Not fixed: the football weekly-standings test checks keys and row counts, not row contents. Row equality holds by construction and is covered by the golden master.
